tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Return today's checked AI claims (releases, tools, techniques), each with its verification status, source trust score and evidence links. Optionally filter by a topic word such as 'claude', 'codex' or 'open weights'. Call this first when the user asks what's new in AI.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Search the claims Context Pill has published (the ledger), with their status at publication, how each was checked, current state (pending, resolved, corrected or closed-inconclusive), the re-check outcome and any correction. Removed items keep only an id, date and reason, so they don't show up in a

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the sources Context Pill reads, with tier, trust score (posterior mean), its conservative lower bound (LB10) and the number of resolved tips. Optionally filter by name. Use it when the user asks how far to trust a source.
